assessment: This study explores a novel mechanistic insight into the epitranscriptomic regulation of murine heart regeneration. The authors have demonstrated that Mettl3 post-transcriptionally reduces Fgf16 mRNA levels through an m6 A-Ythdf2-dependent pathway, thereby restricting cardiomyocyte proliferation and heart regeneration in postnatal mice. Targeting the Mettl3/m6A/Ythdf2/Fgf16 pathway may represent a promising therapeutic strategy to promote the proliferation of cardiomyocytes in mammals.
